We have excerpts about checking whether a scheduled report is still running. They mention that a report can appear to stop silently due to recipient bouncing, but the run history shows outcome, and disabled shows as disabled. Also run history distinguishes between not running and failing to deliver. So answer: there is no explicit notification; you can check Settings → Reports → Scheduled to see status and run history; disabled shows as disabled; failures show reason. So answer accordingly.

function.arguments: {"message":"When a scheduled report is paused or disabled, Meridian doesn’t send a separate alert – it simply stops running. You can verify its status in **Settings → Reports → Scheduled**, where the run history will show the most recent outcome. arguments.message: When a scheduled report is paused or disabled, Meridian doesn’t send a separate alert – it simply stops running. You can verify its status in **Settings → Reports → Scheduled**, where the run history will show the most recent outcome. A disabled report appears as “disabled,” and a failed run will include a failure reason. Checking this page is the way to see whether the report was paused, disabled, or just failed to deliver.
